correctness.rationale: Equivalence to forbidden triples is elementary and bidirectional. Every feasible code is visited exactly once in increasing-index recursion; extension tests cover every excluded word. Independent C++ and Python implementations enumerate exactly 14,584 feasible codes, agree on all 1,092 maximal labeled codes byte-for-byte, and directly compute the nine complete group-action orbits. The 108 eight-word cases uniquely extend to the twelve nine-word codes; no extrapolation beyond this finite universe.

value.rationale: The exact distribution of inclusion-maximal codes is a natural saturation invariant for codeword-by-codeword fingerprint assignment. The minimum terminal size 3 versus optimum 9 quantifies a factor-three greedy shortfall, the absent terminal size 8 and unique eight-to-nine extension characterize a nontrivial boundary, and nine symmetry orbits describe all terminal designs rather than an arbitrary finite slice.
